actions.action: Water only when top 2-3 cm of soil is dry (check soil)
Check pot has drainage holes and isn't in standing water
Slide plant out and inspect roots
Trim rotten roots with clean scissors if present
Repot in fresh well-draining mix with perlite/bark in slightly larger pot if needed
Check leaves and stems for pests
Post clearer photo of roots/soil/pot bottom

reason: The answer diagnoses overwatering when the plant was actually underwatered and needed a thorough soak; its advice to water less and disturb the roots would have delayed the fix and likely worsened the drooping.
